brief:
An Israeli strike on a Palestinian home in Deir el-Balah, central Gaza, killed at least one person and wounded others, Al Jazeera Arabic reported. The attack struck a residential structure in the densely populated area of the coastal territory, where hundreds of thousands of Palestinians remain displaced by the conflict.

The incident adds to the mounting civilian toll in Gaza, where residential neighborhoods have faced repeated military operations. Casualties continue to mount amid the ongoing hostilities, though complete casualty figures remain difficult to verify due to limited access and communications disruptions across the territory. The attack occurred as fighting persists across multiple areas of Gaza.
